fields.label: Content
fields.help: Configure labels and toggle buttons for download and online preview actions.

fields.label: Show Download Button
fields.help: Show or hide the primary download button.

fields.label: Download Button Label
fields.help: Label text for the primary download button.

fields.label: Show Preview/Read Button
fields.help: Show or hide the secondary read / online preview button.

fields.label: Preview Button Label
fields.help: Label text for the secondary preview button.

fields.label: Layout & Style
fields.help: Configure button width and single-line layout behavior.

fields.label: Button Width
fields.help: Choose 'full' for full-width buttons or 'auto' for compact buttons.

fields.label: Keep in One Line
fields.help: Force buttons to remain on a single line without wrapping.

fields.label: Spacing
fields.help: Adjust outer margin spacing above and below buttons.

fields.label: Margin Top
fields.help: Adjust top margin space above the button container.

fields.label: Margin Bottom
fields.help: Adjust bottom margin space below the button container.
